facts.material: plastic pistol-grip body and trigger; air hose assembly
facts.function: hand-operated valve to inflate/deflate tires while a digital gauge displays pressure
facts.form: tire inflator with LCD pressure display, imported with batteries

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 covers taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances for pipes, tanks or the like; the inflator is a hand-operated valve controlling air flow into/out of a tire
GRI 3(b): the valve mechanism, not the digital gauge, gives the essential character (gauge is an aid to operating the valve)
GRI 6: 8481.80 other appliances; hand operated; 8481.80.50 of other materials (plastic body); 8481.80.50.90 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: pressure gauge function is subsidiary to the valve function that controls inflation/deflation
device has no compressor or pump; it only controls air from an external source
body is plastic, not iron or steel

missing_facts: Batteries packed with the inflator may be classified separately (heading 8506)
classification.rationale: The tire inflator is a hand-operated valve in a plastic pistol-grip body that lets the user inflate or deflate a tire while an LCD gauge shows the pressure. CBP classified tire inflators with gauge and gun grip as hand-operated valves of other materials in 8481.80.5090 (N054119, in force). The digital gauge is subsidiary to the valve function, and the plastic body points to the 'other materials' line.
